pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: State baseline list price without fabricating past promotional prices
lesson.when: a customer asks to compare current pricing against a past expired promotion and available sources do not state the exact past discounted price
lesson.do: explain that the past promo has expired, provide the current list price and active benefits, and politely ask if they want to proceed
lesson.otherwise: state uncertainty regarding the exact past promotional price and provide only verified current pricing details
